description: This file defines the I18nController class that implements the ReactiveController interface for handling internationalization (i18n) in a Lit-based web component. It manages subscribing to localization changes and triggers updates when the host connects or disconnects.

classes.name: I18nController
classes.description: A controller for managing i18n subscriptions and triggering host updates in Lit components.

methods.name: hostConnected
methods.description: Sets up a subscription to the i18n service and updates the host when localization data changes.

methods.name: hostDisconnected
methods.description: Cleans up the subscription when the host disconnects.
